new.analysis: The athlete missed the entire previous week, so the focus for this week is a gentle reintroduction to running.  In a build phase we keep most mileage easy, but to keep the training progression we add a single short quality session.  The total time is kept low – about 40 minutes – and the walk‑run format is used for all sessions so the athlete stays comfortable.  Three short easy days provide volume while two rest days keep recovery high.  The 2‑min hard intervals on Friday serve as a taste of threshold work without over‑loading the body.  If any day is missed, we’ll keep the rest day as a real rest and note the missed run in the next week.  The plan should keep the athlete’s heart rate in zones 1–2 for easy runs and have the quality session feel near 7‑8/10 effort.
